purpose: Gate raw half-hour sequence representation families against ID342 for S3/Q3 without creating artifacts.

research_priors.read: Q2/Q3 are expected to respond to daily mobile-app and routine signals, while S3 is more tied to step, light, and time-window features.
S3 is treated as sleep-onset-latency related; pre-sleep screen, light, movement, and HR are prioritized.
Daily/window aggregates closed as negative evidence, so this gate keeps temporal ordering through random convolution features rather than adding another aggregate blend.

families.name: all_channels
families.domain_read: All raw half-hour channels and missingness channels.

families.name: q3_usage_routine
families.domain_read: Q3 stress/fatigue is screened through app use, phone state, mobility, and context routine.

families.name: s3_sleep_boundary
families.domain_read: S3 sleep-onset-latency is screened through evening-to-morning light, motion, HR, and phone state.

families.name: usage_evening
families.domain_read: Evening usage, location/proximity, and ambience may capture recovery load and routine disruption.

families.name: physio_light_sleep
families.domain_read: Physiology, light, movement, and charging/screen context across the pre-sleep and wake boundary.

decision.next_action: No strict S3/Q3 sequence-representation row passed; keep this as negative evidence, not a candidate.
